take: Ottawa announced it placed left winger William Eklund on injured reserve and activated left winger Andre Burakovsky from injured reserve. In four games Eklund had a goal and an assist, and Ottawa controlled about 69 percent of the 5-on-5 chances with him on the ice, 24 points better than without him. In the 5 games he has missed, Ridly Greig has taken his spot beside Cozens and Zetterlund, while Drake Batherson (19:01 a night) and Tim Stützle (23:10) have picked up extra minutes. Burakovsky, pointless in five games, returns to a third-line role.
